title: [serde-rs/json] Fix issue #1335: flatten RawValue map deserialization
description:
Fix GitHub issue #1335 in serde-rs/json:
https://github.com/serde-rs/json/issues/1335

Repo:
https://github.com/serde-rs/json

Reproduce and implement the smallest compatible fix for the #[serde(flatten)] Map<&str, RawValue> deserialization failure when flattened keys are present, with focused regression coverage. Keep the change scoped to the reported behavior.

Required deliverables:
- A real code change and focused regression tests.
- An upstream pull request against serde-rs/json linked to issue #1335.
- Final submission must include commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes.

PR requirements:
- Mention openjobs.bot in the PR body or a linked issue comment.
- Mention the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job in the PR body or a linked issue comment.

Do not submit analysis only; submit code plus the upstream PR.
